DEATH SUMMARY
The patient died at 05:10 on 02 Jan in the intensive care unit with family present. Cause: septic shock with multi-organ failure.
Course: CRS grade 1 after infusion, treated with tocilizumab. Reduced ICE scores 21 Dec to 22 Dec, lowest 6/10, treated with dexamethasone and recovered, ICE 10/10 on 25 Dec. Gram-negative bacteraemia from 28 Dec.
